subject: ClearSight renewal: convert to cloud marketplace billing
messages:
From: Lisa Hart <lisa.hart@clearsight.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal & Marketplace invoicing for Redwood - ClearSight

Hey Jordan,

We’re starting renewal planning for our Redwood subscription (current term ends 2027-05-31) and procurement has flagged a hard requirement: our finance team wants to purchase via AWS Marketplace (Marketplace invoicing + PO) rather than a direct vendor invoice.

Is that something Redwood can accommodate? If so, what’s the timeline and what do you need from our side (AWS Account ID, PO form, statement of work amendment)? Ideally we’d prefer the billing to switch on our next renewal invoice. Happy to jump on a short call this week.

Thanks,
Lisa Hart
VP Finance
ClearSight Analytics

Attachment: PO_template_Clearsight.pdf (pdf, 45KB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Hart <lisa.hart@clearsight.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & Marketplace invoicing for Redwood - ClearSight

Hi Lisa — thanks for the note. Yes, we can convert your account to AWS Marketplace billing ahead of renewal. High-level plan: 

- Collect AWS Account ID and current subscription info (subscription ID, SKUs, current ARR).
- Prepare a short amendment and DocuSign so procurement has a marketplace-friendly contract path.
- Register the subscription on AWS Marketplace (seller side) and set the effective date for the next invoice period (target June 1, 2027).
- Coordinate with Redwood Billing/Finance to transition invoicing and set up PO acceptance.

I’ve attached our quick Co-Sell / Marketplace checklist and a short migration workbook that helps map invoices and subscription SKUs. Can we schedule a 30-min call tomorrow 10–10:30am PT to capture your AWS Account ID and procurement fields? If that works I’ll loop in our marketplace team and Sales Ops/Finance.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com (415) 555-0182

Attachments: Redwood_CoSell_Checklist.pdf, Clearsight_MAP_Migration_MVP.xlsx

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: ClearSight renewal - Marketplace conversion request (need ops + partner help)

Team — forwarding ClearSight request. Quick asks: 

1) Marcus: can Partner Ops fast-track ClearSight to the AWS Marketplace listing? They’re a straightforward renewal (no technical integration) and want billing via marketplace effective 2027-06-01.

2) Monica / Billing: what’s the minimum lead time we need to switch invoicing for their account, and can we generate a one-line invoice change summary I can send to their procurement? Also, is there any internal policy on offering conversion credits or incentives? Sales would like to offer a one-time credit to make the procurement change easier.

Proposed next steps: Marcus to confirm registration steps and timeline; Monica to share invoice-change CSV and any required amendment template; I’ll own the DocuSign and customer comms.

Thanks,
Jordan

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 10:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: ClearSight renewal - Marketplace conversion request (need ops + partner help)

Jordan — we can fast-track this. Notes from Partner Ops: 

- Required from ClearSight: AWS Account ID, desired effective invoice date (you proposed 2027-06-01), and confirmation of SKUs to map.
- Marketplace registration (seller-side) can complete in ~5 business days once we have the account id and amendment signed — we’ll work with AWS Marketplace contact for a fast-track listing.
- Incentives: partner approves a one-time marketplace conversion credit up to 5% of one renewal invoice (not recurring). If sales wants a larger credit, we need approval from Revenue Ops and Partner Director.

Monica — can you produce the Invoice_Change_Summary.csv showing current invoice line mapping and the expected line mapping post-marketplace? Also confirm whether finance can accept PO numbers in the AWS Marketplace flow (most of the time yes, but we need to show the PO field in the AWS order).

I’ll also open a ticket with AWS Marketplace contacts to accelerate approval: aws-marketplace-seller@amazon.com.

Marcus
Head of Partner Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 13:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice mapping and PO handling for ClearSight marketplace move

Jordan / Marcus — attached is the invoice change summary mapping (CSV) and a short list of fields procurement usually needs for acceptance via Marketplace: billing address, PO number field, tax ID, and a marketplace order reference. Lead time: to reflect the change on ClearSight’s June 1 invoice, we need final amendment signed and AWS Account ID by Monday 2027-04-12 EOD.

On credits: finance can approve a one-time credit; please provide targeted credit amount and justification. For transparency, include it as a one-line credit in the amendment so AWS sees the net price.

Files attached: Invoice_Change_Summary.csv

Thanks,
Monica
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & Marketplace invoicing for Redwood - ClearSight

Lisa — quick update and next concrete steps: 

- We can convert ClearSight to AWS Marketplace billing effective on your next invoice period (target: 2027-06-01).
- What we need from you: AWS Account ID, confirmation of the SKUs you currently consume (I’ve listed them in the attached migration workbook), and a signed amendment (DocuSign link below). Please provide these by Monday 2027-04-12 to hit the June 1 target.
- Incentive: Redwood will apply a one-time 5% conversion credit on your first marketplace invoice to help with procurement sign-off. This will appear as a line item in the amendment and on the net price that’s registered to Marketplace.
- I’ve looped in Partner Ops (Marcus) and Sales Ops (Monica) who will execute registration and the invoice mapping.

DocuSign amendment: https://app.docusign.com/clear-sign/ABC-1234-REDWOOD-CLEARSIGHT
HubSpot deal record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DA-2027-0423

If the Monday deadline is tight, propose a 15-min check-in this afternoon to walk through the AWS Account ID and I’ll start the amendment.

Thanks — Jordan
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
